name: Pingnan Third Bridge
facts: Pingnan Third Bridge, completed December 28, 2020, boasts a 575‑meter CFST arch—world’s second‑largest after Tian'e‑Longtan—spanning the Xun River in Guangxi province.
Its 34.3‑meter‑wide red arch, composed of four 140‑cm steel tubes per rib, was prefabricated in sections up to 215 tons, shipped by boat, and lifted by a massive cable crane.
Construction began August 7, 2018; the northern abutment required pioneering foundation work on gravel, while the southern abutment rested on bedrock, showcasing advanced geotechnical techniques.
